newsitem.title: GERMANY: RESEARCH ALERT-Paribas keeps VW as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Paribas keeps VW as buy.

text.p: Banque Paribas said on Wednesday it has reaffirmed its buy rating on Volkswagen AG and expected the German carmaker's shares to outperform the DAX index by a 16 percentage-point margin.
"VW can no longer be considered as a 'cheap' stock but the positive momentum on sales, costs and currencies should enable the stock to perform further in the next year," the report said.
The report also projected growth in DVFA earnings per share at VW to 75.08 marks in 1997 and to 100.56 marks in 1998, up from 55 marks in 1996.
Paribas said VW's volumes continue to rise with recurrent market share gains in Europe and a double-digit growth on other marks.

The weakening mark and the strength of the pound and the dollar in particular reinforce the group's competitive position, noting also the VW group reached a historically high market share of 18.8 percent in June in Europe.
Paribas said it forecast an eight percent rise in global volume sales for 1997 at 4.3 million vehicles and that sales growth should continue at eight percent in 1998 and 1999.
The report said VW is still 11 percent below the European average for price-earnings ratios in terms of valuation.
